# Phobos Shipbreaker: equipment and item reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-item-reference.ps1. Edit config/item-reference.json, not this file. -->

Current source candidate: **0.46.0**. Game target: **1.0.1.5**. Values below come from offline definitions; they do not establish installation, gameplay validation or a live merchant quote.

Rivetline machinery recovers material and casts rough industrial products. Asterel C1 provides optional central controls. Obtain loose equipment, place it through the indicated native INSTALL tab, supply electricity where required, and keep service approaches accessible. Local panels remain usable without C1. Receiving, processing and hot-furnace controls are separate permissions. Pending-equipment reloads include a bounded room-grid mitigation; see [evidence and limits](development/shipbreaker-room-load-mitigation.md). It cannot recover atmosphere already lost before saving. Regional offers extend through the current vanilla solar system; see [market coverage and the game's market pricing](solar-system-economy.md). Crew standing orders are opt-in; see [crew work, training and time-skips](crew-automation.md) for eligible work, approved stores, resource limits and resuming industrial and exterior work. Compact controls, unsaved settings and object selection are explained in the [control-panel guide](control-panel-guide.md). In selection fields, Locate opens a temporary marked ship view; Clear is a draft change that requires Apply. Pick on ship marks eligible objects and Escape restores the panel and view.

**Reading prices:** credits per complete object at the stated condition, before shop margins, market effects, negotiation and extra wear. Pristine retail can cost more. Mass is the empty/dry definition or fresh commodity template; saved contents and variable recovery packets can weigh differently. Dismantle value is the sum of all listed outputs at base value, excluding labour and tools.

**Repair and Restore:** Repair fixes a damaged form and retains the actual consumed service materials as spent parts. Restore reduces wear on functional equipment in place; it does not grant pristine status. Empty cargo and follow the machine’s local maintenance guards first. Work speed depends on crew, tools and current condition.

**Finding stock:** the generated percentages are defaults per eligible native stock/loot roll, not per ship or guaranteed shop availability. Offers are additive, may be independent, and require normal restocking. Merchant offers request the listed finite lot when successful; separate world-loot branches retain their own listed quantities. Configuration, capacity and native generation rules still apply; loading an existing save does not refill its inventories.

**Stacking:** limits below apply to loose items on the ground or in compatible containers; 1 means no multi-item stack. Installed equipment remains individual. Limits count objects, not kilograms, and do not change merchant lot sizes or per-object contents.

## D4 Dismantling Fixture

Processes detached structural parts (ordinary walls of any make, floor grates, DuraWal, Whipple and aero panels, windows) into native scrap and parts; a wall also returns the identified residue packet, a lighter part a terminal reject.

**Use:** Install on cabin flooring and supply power. Put detached structural parts (ordinary walls of any make at 14 to 48 kg, floor grates, DuraWal, Whipple and aero panels, windows) in its Part Feed through the Control Panel, switch on Load feed by crew so crew keep it loaded from anywhere aboard, or use the G4/H4 intake; then enable processing once and the queue waits for more. Products appear in the normal machine inventory. To move ordinary products out automatically, choose a storage container on the Routing page and Start unloading to storage; see [storage outputs](automatic-material-routing.md#storage-outputs-for-ordinary-products). Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.

**Where it appears:** Buy loose or damaged equipment, or build two D4-S sections and assemble the fixture. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Final assembly now takes place at the installation site through Install on a section or INSTALL > APPS; a complete loose machine keeps its direct Install action.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS starts assembly from matching sections. A complete loose machine keeps its own direct Install action; damaged forms retain their existing placement path.

It does not cut attached hull walls. Doors, hatches, conduit, furniture and machinery are refused. Fresh wall jobs make identified R2 feed; older bound jobs retain their original mixed-residue output. Processing and storage unloading pause on reload.

Full operating instructions: [D4 Dismantling Fixture guide](development/shipbreaker-first-build.md).

## G4 Exterior Grabber

Receives detached wall panels and, when explicitly enabled, cuts supported captured walls for the existing D4 chain.

**Use:** Install the G4/H4/D4 assembly with all four backing walls intact. Manual loading and intake still work. For automatic reclamation, bind the exact G4 and N1/N2 console to an owned, unoccupied wreck, then choose Start reclamation. Resume is required after loading or lost authority. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.

**Where it appears:** Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

| Operating mode (functional, installed) | Powered seconds | Demand (kW) | Nominal work energy (kWh) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Powered wall cutting | 120 | 12 | 0.4000 |
| Existing G4 intake transfer | 5 | 2 | 0.0028 |

Authored default work values. Cutting captures its duration and demand per started wall; partial delivered electricity earns proportional progress. Modes run sequentially. D4/R4 work and idle consumption are additional.

Requires Auto Nav and Framework; see the installation guide for current minimum versions. Cutting, feeding, release, outward retreat, traversal and recapture are sequenced. Cutting rejects its delivered electrical energy as heat through the D4 interior service area (at least 10 kPa and headroom below 40 C); this is authored gameplay cooling, not a simulated physical coolant circuit. Only empty, unstacked, undamaged ordinary walls of any make (14 to 48 kg) with retained floors/supports qualify. Target pressure must be at most 0.1 kPa. Stop retains the capture; Release is separate. Floors, other equipment, cargo and final supports remain.

Full operating instructions: [G4 Exterior Grabber guide](shipbreaker-reclamation.md).

## H4 Sealed Hull Chute

Connects the exterior grabber and interior processor across intact structural flooring.

**Use:** Install in the documented G4 → H4 → D4 arrangement; align and power the associated equipment.

**Where it appears:** Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Backing walls remain the pressure barrier. The chute is not an open portal, pressure-cycling airlock or arbitrary conveyor network.

Full operating instructions: [H4 Sealed Hull Chute guide](shipbreaker-hull-intake.md).

## C2 Residue Collector

A finite physical cargo receiver for explicitly paired industrial outputs.

**Use:** Install on two structural floor tiles with a clear two-tile service walkway, or at the hull with the existing wall supports. Link the required machine/output port, select an exact filter and enable receiving. For Agriculture's optional Recycler capture, align the full two-tile pocket against the Recycler with the service side facing away; enable collection from the Recycler panel. Empty Inventory when full. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.

**Where it appears:** Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Full collectors block transfer; cargo stays at the sender. It does not jettison material or reduce ship mass. Furnace products need their explicit filter.

Full operating instructions: [C2 Residue Collector guide](residue-collector.md).

## R4 Scrap Reclaimer

Reclaims identified R2 panel residue into steel, aluminium and terminal rejects.

**Use:** Supply power and adequate cabin atmosphere, load exact R2 feed locally, switch on Load feed by crew or enable a paired intake, then start processing. Set residue, aluminium and steel storage outputs independently; see [storage outputs](automatic-material-routing.md#storage-outputs-for-ordinary-products). Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.

**Where it appears:** Buy machinery or assemble two R4-S sections. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Final assembly now takes place at the installation site through Install on a section or INSTALL > APPS; a complete loose machine keeps its direct Install action.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS starts assembly from matching sections. A complete loose machine keeps its own direct Install action; damaged forms retain their existing placement path.

Legacy mixed residue and terminal rejects are not valid feed. The machine puts heat into cabin gas; vacuum is not free cooling. Receiving, processing and storage unloading pause on reload.

Full operating instructions: [R4 Scrap Reclaimer guide](scrap-reclaimer.md).

## F6 Electric Furnace

Electrically heats an exact aluminium charge to cast a rough machinery housing.

**Use:** Build or buy the furnace, install it with a compatible cooling endpoint and power. Use the local panel to load (or Load feed by crew for single aluminium pieces), seal, heat and cast, then cool, equalize and release products. Follow the complete cycle guide, or choose [Repeat batches](furnace-player-guide.md#repeat-batches) to seal, run, equalize and release each full charge automatically. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.

**Where it appears:** Buy machinery or assemble three F6-S sections. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Final assembly now takes place at the installation site through Install on a section or INSTALL > APPS; a complete loose machine keeps its direct Install action.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS starts assembly from matching sections. A complete loose machine keeps its own direct Install action; damaged forms retain their existing placement path.

Requires finite cooling and a valid gas receiver. Direct coupling can transfer heat without power; piped circulation requires pump electricity. Automatic material receipt never authorizes Seal, Start or Release; only an explicitly started repeat run does, and it pauses on any manoeuvre, interruption, manual control or reload. Hot machinery retains heat across saves.

Full operating instructions: [F6 Electric Furnace guide](furnace-player-guide.md).

<a id="f6r"></a>

## F6-R Exterior Radiator

Rejects furnace heat through a finite exterior cooling assembly.

**Use:** Install in the documented exterior location and pair with the F6. Direct coupling or the optional dedicated coolant route is supported.

**Where it appears:** Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.

**Placement:** INSTALL → HVAC. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

One cooling endpoint per furnace. Direct coupling is passive; a remote piped installation needs powered circulation. A disconnected exposed radiator still rejects heat already in its own store. It is not an unlimited heat sink; do not switch pairs or modes while hot. If older saves left cargo inside, choose Recover stored cargo while beside the unit and move the items out. New deposits are blocked. Maintenance information identifies contents, coolant, heat and paired-equipment restrictions. Actual work lots remain reserved until their native job finishes or is cancelled.

Full operating instructions: [F6-R Exterior Radiator guide](furnace-player-guide.md).

## F6-C Sealed Coolant Conduit

Provides the separate coolant route between the F6 and a remote F6-R.

**Use:** Place contiguous segments through HVAC, connect the correct cooling endpoints and select piped mode while cool and empty. Use the furnace’s checked routing controls.

**Where it appears:** Buy ordinary supply/fixer/Halvorson stock or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.

**Placement:** INSTALL → HVAC. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

This is not electrical cable or irrigation pipe. Legacy sealed operation and optional finite coolant servicing have different requirements. Damaged forms retain separate identities even when the display name lacks a damage suffix. Loose intact and damaged sections support storage stacks, separately by identity; installed segments remain individual fixtures. Split off a section when an action requires an individual item.

Full operating instructions: [F6-C Sealed Coolant Conduit guide](furnace-coolant-conduits.md).

## C1 Industrial Control Console

Provides central status and checked commands for installed industrial equipment on its own ship, with optional Agriculture integration.

Physical cargo access and maintenance remain local. Docked, moored and towed ships are separate scopes; C1 is not required for autonomous processing.

<a id="s3"></a>

## S3, S4 and S5 Process Water Silos

Passive vessels holding process water as a saved record: the 3 x 3 S3 holds 1,000 kg, the 4 x 4 S4 1,960 kg and the 5 x 5 S5 3,330 kg. Bigger silos hold more for less per kilogram of capacity; a full silo weighs its housing plus its water.

**Use:** Install through APPS; no power or inventory. Fill at a station under Bulk supplies, from a linked T2 within one tile, or (with Ship's Water 0.16.1) draw from the drinking-water tanks above the crew reserve; send water to the waste tanks for the Recycler. Set Keep in reserve on the panel or C1, in steps of the silo's size. After damage, repair and Recover trapped water; a protected silo offers Accept contents as they are. See [the silo guide](shipbreaker-bulk-silos.md).

**Where it appears:** Buy loose hardware from the sellers below. No fabrication recipe. The S3 may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; the S4 and S5 are too big to turn up in salvage. See the exact offers below.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Process water only: never a drinking-water tank, never fuel. Uninstalling carries the water with the loose silo; Dismantle is refused while water remains, and removal is refused while the silo is protected. Water is lost with a destroyed silo (logged). A linked Agriculture R3 and, with Phobos Manufacturing, the X2, V4 and K2 use or fill silo water.

Full operating instructions: [S3, S4 and S5 Process Water Silos guide](shipbreaker-bulk-silos.md).

<a id="y2"></a>

## Y2, Y3 and Y4 Material Bins

Sealed, unpowered stores for mined material: ore, loose regolith, gangue, water and methane ice, ice gangue and mined chunks such as clay hydrates. The 2 x 2 Y2 has a 4 x 4 grid, the 3 x 3 Y3 a 6 x 6 grid and the 4 x 4 Y4 an 8 x 8 grid; ore stacks six to a cell, so a Y2 holds about a tonne of ore. Every block keeps its own identity and mass.

**Use:** Install through FURN like the game's Storage Bay, then open its Inventory and put mined material in. Crew treat an installed bin as an ordinary unlocked container: Load feed by crew can fetch from it (choose it, or leave the ship-wide search on) and a machine's crew order can send gangue and other mined products into it. It takes nothing but mined material. See [the bin guide](shipbreaker-material-bins.md).

**Where it appears:** Buy loose hardware from the sellers below. No fabrication recipe. The Y2 may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; the Y3 and Y4 are too big to turn up in salvage. See the exact offers below.

**Placement:** INSTALL → FURN. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Uninstalling carries the contents with the loose bin, as the game's own Storage Bay does, so a full bin is very heavy. Dismantle is refused until the bin is empty. The D4 and R4 storage outputs do not list bins, because bins refuse their scrap products.

Full operating instructions: [Y2, Y3 and Y4 Material Bins guide](shipbreaker-material-bins.md).

<a id="t2"></a>

## T2 Ice Thaw Unit

Thaws one block of the game's water ice (24.7 kg) at a time into 22.7 kg of process water for a linked silo or R3 reservoir plus one 2 kg gangue packet in its tray. It also breaks down methane ice (24.84 kg): 19.89 kg of water to the silo and 2.95 kg of methane to a linked Phobos Manufacturing methane store, never into the air.

**Use:** Install through APPS within one tile of the vessel, connect power, choose Deliver water to on its panel or C1, place single ice blocks in the Ice Feed (Inventory opens the tray and the feed) or switch on Load feed by crew, then Start / resume thawing. 6 kW for 40 minutes a block of water ice, 50 minutes for methane ice; part of it warms the room. For methane ice also choose Send methane to on the panel (it appears once a methane store is within one tile). See [the silo guide](shipbreaker-bulk-silos.md).

**Where it appears:** Buy loose hardware from the sellers below. No fabrication recipe. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Gangue and stacked blocks are refused; methane ice waits until a methane store is linked, and crew only bring it once one is. Nothing warms until the linked vessel has room for a whole block; a hot or airless room makes it wait. Reload pauses it; Start or a crew order resumes. Empty the two-cell gangue tray by hand or a crew output store.

Full operating instructions: [T2 Ice Thaw Unit guide](shipbreaker-bulk-silos.md).

<a id="d4-section"></a>

## D4-S assembly section

A heavy, unpowered construction component, not a functional machine.

**Use:** Choose Assembly information on the section for instructions. Choose Install on it, or D4 in INSTALL > APPS, and place the construction site. Native hauling delivers two matching sections separately; use Mortorq and soldering tools to finish the installed machine. Final assembly does not use a table. See [construction sites](section-assembly-and-maintenance.md).

**Where it appears:** Construct from materials, buy the listed section offers, or obtain a native engineering-loot section.

**Placement:** Choose Install on this section or the completed machine in INSTALL → APPS. This starts a construction site; deliver the full section bill separately.

Sections use the drag slot, not your hands. A section already held in an older save remains there until released. Native site cancellation returns delivered parts; save/reload keeps the site and its work. Dismantle salvages the section rather than assembling it. Old table action identities remain for saved queues, but no longer appear as new offers. The site shows an unfinished frame while parts arrive, then open machinery once the full bill is present and work starts; the finished form appears only after completion.

Full operating instructions: [D4-S assembly section guide](equipment-economy.md).

<a id="coolant"></a>

## Thermal Service Fluid Charge

Fresh fictional industrial coolant for optional finite F6 servicing.

**Use:** In cool, idle piped mode enable finite servicing, place charges in Products and load locally. Prime before operating.

**Where it appears:** Ordinary supply, fixer or Halvorson stock as listed below.

**Placement:** Inventory/module-slot item; no standalone INSTALL entry.

Not drinking water, irrigation feed or ammonia. The legacy sealed cooling mode does not require these charges. Fresh thermal service fluid charges support storage stacks of three. Split off one before furnace filling; retained coolant remains individual.

<a id="compartments"></a>

## Built-in feed compartments

Named child inventories built into D4, R4, F6 and T2. They are not separate products.

**Use:** Open the compartment from the machine's Control Panel (the ordinary Inventory is the product tray) and put only its accepted structural parts (ordinary walls of any make, floor grates, DuraWal, Whipple and aero panels, windows), R2 residue, single 1 kg pieces of the metal the selected furnace recipe takes, or single blocks of water ice there, or switch on Load feed by crew.

**Where it appears:** Shown as feed/chamber inventory within their owning machine.

**Placement:** Built into its parent machine; not separately installable.

No purchase, INSTALL, repair, Restore or standalone salvage contract. Empty-machine checks include these compartments.

Full operating instructions: [Built-in feed compartments guide](industrial-console-player-guide.md).

Included compartments: Phobos' Rivetline D4 Part Feed (4 parts: ordinary walls 14 to 48 kg, floor grates and light panels); Phobos' Rivetline R4 Reclaimer Feed; Phobos' Rivetline F6 Charge chamber; Phobos' Rivetline T2 Ice Feed.

## Construction-site assembly

## Evidence and upkeep

Item names, dry/template masses, prices, service bills, salvage outputs, placement tabs, stock probabilities and table recipes are generated from current Phobos definitions. **Blue Bottle Games’ Ostranauts** native `DataCO.GetBasePrice` supplies the offline valuation used here ([developer’s game page](https://bluebottlegames.com/games/ostranauts)). That page identifies the game; the actual numeric evidence is the locally inspected assembly, whose hash is retained in the generated data snapshot. No proprietary source or game assembly is distributed.

Function/use explanations are maintained in the reviewed catalogue. All fictional prices, yields and simplified processing are Phobos gameplay choices. Research attribution remains beside the relevant claims in the linked operating/research guides. See [reference maintenance](development/item-reference-maintenance.md) for the one-click updater and coverage checks.
